successes_found: Burn-on-parse front-run DoS — one mechanism, independently authored by all 4 blind authors (slots B01/B06/B11/B16). Unauthenticated presentation of an owner nonce burns it before signature validation, denying the owner genuine submission. Availability axis only: no privilege escalation, no state corruption, recovery is a fresh nonce.
healing: SIP-026 sender-scoped nonce consumption — burn key = (authenticated submitter, nonce); an attacker-authenticated frame burns nothing in the owner namespace; same-namespace replay still refused. Forward-only gate amendment v1.2 (sha ef7076d8); v1.1 untouched.
series.verification: BLIND-2R: all 20 frozen slots re-run against gate v1.2 — 20/20 REPELLED. Replay-regression control PASS: owner first use ADMITTED, same-namespace replay refused ERR_REPLAY_NONCE_ALREADY_USED (SIP-024 closure preserved).

series.convergence_note: All four independent blind authors converged on the same mechanism (confidences 0.95/0.95/0.90/0.95) — strongest possible blind evidence that it is the salient gap. 16 repelled slots incl. KAT key-type substitution, prompt-injection relay, failed-receipt verdict decoupling, ACK-queue saturation.

rebuild.error: Burn-on-parse front-run DoS: any presentation of an authorization nonce consumed it at parse, before signature validation — an unauthenticated frame presenting the owner active nonce burned it, denying the owner genuine submission (ERR_REPLAY_NONCE_ALREADY_USED). Availability axis only: no privilege escalation, no state corruption, fresh-nonce recovery verified by control.
rebuild.fix: SIP-026 sender-scoped nonce consumption: burn key = (authenticated submitter, nonce). Submitter identity comes from the authenticated envelope, never message content. An attacker-authenticated presentation burns only the attacker namespace. Forward-only gate amendment v1.2 (sha ef7076d8); v1.1 and its evidence untouched.
rebuild.heal: BLIND-2R: all 20 frozen slots re-executed against gate v1.2 (harness = deterministic transform of the frozen battery; specs untouched, sha 46d24736): 20/20 REPELLED. Replay-regression control PASS — the fix closes the front-run DoS without reopening the BLIND-1 replay oracle.
rebuild.rebuild: (1) verify frozen-corpus shas (allowlist 2c8ff6eb, keysets 502ef8b0, gate v1.1 1fb167c6); (2) run blind2_battery.py -> expect 16 repelled / 4 attacker successes (slots B01/B06/B11/B16, the front-run DoS); (3) apply gate v1.2 (SIP-026); (4) run blind2r_battery.py -> expect 20/20 REPELLED + replay-regression control PASS.
